summary: Metabase is a web-based analytics tool that lets you connect to various databases and explore data through queries and visualisations. It is designed to make data querying accessible to both technical and non-technical users within an organisation. The application is built with Java and distributed as a container image.
goodFor: Teams that need a self-hosted business intelligence interface allowing multiple users to run queries and build dashboards without writing raw SQL every time.
watchOut: The software is licensed under the AGPL-3.0, which imposes strict copyleft obligations if you modify the code or offer it as a hosted service to third parties. It also requires careful access management to prevent users from accidentally executing expensive database queries.
deployNotes: You will typically deploy it using Docker, attaching a persistent volume for internal application data and configuring a separate application database such as PostgreSQL for production use. A reverse proxy is usually required in front of the container to handle TLS termination.
